 Standard Chartered Bank  Oct 2025 till Present 
Manager – GBS CPM Governance Roles & 
Responsibilities: 
 
Credit & Portfolio Management (CPM) – Analytics & Governance 
. 
1- Develop and maintain CPM dashboards including CPM MI Packs, OBL MI Packs, GCLO Packs and Regional 
Portfolio Reports. 
2- Prepare RHCIC packs, Priority Sale Reports and Minimum Retained Uninsured reports for respective CROs. 
3-Maintain and update Loan Sales Database including RMI, PMI, SCI, Creditmate and ACBS data. 
4- Support IBSM Deal Direction process, manage deal flow and ensure optimal capital & liquidity utilisation. 
5- Collaborate with Group Treasury and Business teams to monitor OBL capacity, utilisation trends and offshore 
deal volumes. 
6-Ensure DOI, DM and related internal documentation are updated and compliant with policy requirements. 
 
SAG & Regulatory Reporting 
 
1- Manage Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annual and annual regulatory & non-regulatory reporting. 
2- Coordinate with in-country RMs, Account Managers and Account Owners for SAG client clarifications. 
3- Ensure accurate client data maintenance in systems such as Amadeus/RV2. 
4- Support regulatory requirements including FATCA, BHCA, Volcker reporting and Due Diligence activities. 
 
Principle Finance & Vendor Governance 
 
1-Maintain investment records in bank applications; ensure timely updates for new investments/exits. 
2- Process third-party payments in compliance with bank payment policies. 
3- Manage vendor onboarding including vendor creation and third-party security assessments. 
4- Maintain investment registers and ensure compliance with internal & external regulatory frameworks. 
 
Assurance, Risk & Controls 
 
1- Perform Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annual and Annual CST & KCI monitoring. 
2- Ensure metrics are recorded in M7 within defined timelines with proper supporting documentation. 
3- Prepare and publish NFRC MI reports. 
4- Conduct exception analysis and ensure alignment with CPO/GPO prior to recording. 
5-Embed Operational Risk Framework into CPM monitoring processes and escalate issues where required. 
• Drive automation initiatives in collaboration with Operational Excellence & Change teams. 
 
Governance & Stakeholder Management 
• Partner with CPM Management, Risk, Front Office and Coverage teams to improve client experience and 
processing efficiency. 
• Support new business/product programs and country addendums. 
• Ensure compliance with Group Code of Conduct, regulatory standards and internal governance frameworks. 
• Contribute to innovation, automation and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 
 
Societe Generale Global Solution Centre Pvt Ltd Nov 2021 till Oct 2025 
Senior Analyst – Operational Risk Management Roles 
& Responsibilities: 
 
● Governance - Stakeholder Management – 
1. Set up meeting for regular connects with stakeholders 
2. Manage meetings independently and contribute actively in discussion and identify points of action for 
all participants 
3. Listen to internal partners and colleagues in order to understand and anticipate their needs 
4. Maintain awareness of the NFR Framework, work across the 3 lines of defense management model to 
ensure risks are managed within Risk appetite. 
5. Maintain and observe internal control standards and implement non-financial risk framework. 
6. Help protect the bank from potential regulatory censure and reduce the impact of 2nd/3rd Line reviews. 
7. Detailed Control testing of High priority controls to ensure Compliance of Regulatory norms. 
8. Testing of processes to ensure teams are adhering to current regulations, notification received on new 
regulations etc. 
● Managerial Controls: 
1. Provide support to business in the modification /creation of managerial controls to ensure that controls 
are setup in a complete, accurate and timely manner, while meeting PCT requirements. 
2. Anomaly management - Ensure that anomalies are effectively managed and tracked to closure 
3. Planning Annual sessions and creating training materials. 
● Incident Management: 
1. Incidents as defined by SG policies are captured in a timely manner, proper root cause analysis is 
performed along with corrective/preventive actions and incidents are tracked to effective closure 
2. Challenge business and provide guidance when required. 
3. Log incidents in the management tool, prepare detailed root cause analysis document. Ensure end to 
end cycle from logging to closure with lessons learnt and implementing action plans are tracked, 
monitored and closed. 
● Support Activities: 
1. Audit Support: Support business and IGAD in the effective closure of audit recos. 
2. DLP / LAC / MAM: Provide support to InfoSec / ORM and ensure that these alerts are resolved in a 
timely and accurate manner 
3. Publish KI/ KRI details accurately as per the timelines and follow up with the business on outstanding 
items. 
4. Provide proactive guidance and support to stakeholders regarding the management of non-financial 
Risk. 
5. Conduct Risk awareness session periodically. 
● RRM/ MRM/ Governance Meetings: 
1. Prepare and present RRM Decks for monthly connects with BL Heads and different stakeholders on all 
risk topics independently. 
2. Providing details required for other governance meetings like the Operational Risk Committees. 
● Risk Assessment: 
1. Independently perform assessments in timely manner and accurate manner and capture material 
risks that affect the process. 
2. Actions plans are discussed and agreed with Business and also presented to various stakeholders 
effectively. All Action items are tracked to effective closure 
3. RCSA: 
1. RCSA process is performed as per the schedule and all risks are captured. 
2. Challenge BL appropriately basis prior incidents, audit recos, anomalies etc. to identify new risks. 
3. Create RCSA synthesis to be presented to BL head. 
4. Reviews the above activities and ensure quality of deliverables. Provide direction / guidance to ORM. 
5. Performed Operational Risk Assessments, RCSA, and control testing across Payments processes, 
identifying control gaps, validating remediation plans, and ensuring compliance with regulatory 
requirements and internal risk frameworks.  
6. Partnered with global Payments Operations, Business, Compliance, and Risk stakeholders to manage 
payment-related incidents, perform root cause analysis, monitor KRIs/KCIs, and strengthen the end-to-
end risk and control environment 
 
 
 
 Genpact India Pvt Ltd Jan 2020 till Oct 2021 
Business Analyst - Control Operations Roles & 
Responsibilities: 
 
● Issue & Action Plans: Support the full lifecycle of an issue and action plan by capturing details in the 
Operational Risk System, tracking progress to ensure timely closure, ownership change updates, close 
action plans after obtaining appropriate evidence to substantiate closure, escalation of potential 
delays, obtain approval for extensions. 
● Risk Events: Support the full lifecycle of a risk event including input of all required error details into 
the Operational Risk System, tracking of open risk events, ensure CIB risk event standards are 
complied with, and maintain error escalation lists, and risk event data quality review and tracking of 
error corrective actions. 
● RCSA (Risk & Control Self-Assessment): Maintain structural and related data including 
management of business hierarchy changes, Cross LOB Consistency reviews, RCSA Calibration 
exercises, PARCs (Process Activity, Risk and Control), Inherent Risk Weightings, Control Ratings, 
Business Guidance and Procedures and issue/action plan linkages. Represent the BCO team at CIB 
RCSA governance meetings and manage all BAU requests. Ensure CIB/Corporate RCSA standards 
are complied with. 
● Business Control Committees (BCC), Business Control Forums (BCF) and related meetings: 
Responsible for the overall meeting administration which includes production and distribution of the 
materials, quality review of data within the materials, and manage the meeting invite. 
● Operational Risk Reports: Creating standard and ad-hoc reports relating to the RCSA, 
Issues/Action Plans, Risk Events, and Aggregated Risk Profile and related key operational risk 
reporting. 
● BCO Data Repository: Responsible for the document updates and maintenance of the BCO 
SharePoint site. 
● Other: Operational Risk System Recertification and Ad-hoc risk / control data management requests 
 
Zyme Solution Pvt Ltd                             July 2017 till Jan 2021

● Responsible for handling the Data processing and Analysis Data Extraction from source, data manipulation &
